option_relations.rationale: IgG4-related rhinosinusitis with concurrent Streptococcus constellatus bacterial rhinosinusitis is a specific instance of IgG4-Related Disease (IgG4-RD) with Orbital/Sinus Involvement and Bacterial Rhinosinusitis with Orbital Complications
IgG4-related disease is a broader class containing IgG4-Related Disease (IgG4-RD) with Orbital/Sinus Involvement
IgG4-Related Disease (IgG4-RD) with Orbital/Sinus Involvement is equivalent to the leaf with the same label

Invasive bacterial rhinosinusitis with orbital apex syndrome is a specific instance of Bacterial Rhinosinusitis with Orbital Complications and Acute/Chronic Bacterial Rhinosinusitis with Orbital Complications
